scope: Forty independently reviewed tenant domains migrated from quota-limited Cloudflare Worker routes to the Hostinger direct origin.

checks.cleanBuild: The clean 5a409d3 release built 3,040 static pages and the resulting production container is healthy with zero restarts.
checks.localPortfolio: All 42 configured tenants passed the isolated origin audit: 305 sitemap pages, 84 desktop/mobile views, no failures, and 0.5571 maximum five-word homepage shingle similarity.
checks.productionPortfolio: All 40 direct-origin tenants passed the final live audit: 293 sitemap pages and 80 desktop/mobile views returned 200 with no overflow, broken images, page errors or console errors.
checks.technicalSeo: Every reviewed page passed title, description, exact self-canonical, robots, sitemap, favicon and structured-data checks. Unreviewed product directories remain noindex and outside the sitemaps.
checks.duplicateContent: The maximum live homepage similarity is 0.5571, below the 0.60 release threshold. Search intent, content order, research workflow and visual composition remain tenant-specific.
checks.automatedTests: The web application passed 128 test suites and 837 tests. The tenant Worker package passed TypeScript, 12 Vitest tests and a Wrangler production dry run.
checks.mainSiteIsolation: https://indexfinds.com/en and https://api-next.indexfinds.com/health returned 200 after the migration. Registration remains intentionally unavailable.
checks.catalogSnapshot: The live public stats endpoint reported 77,973 products, 374 brands and 203 categories at validation time.
checks.runtime: The direct tenant container, main web container and API container are healthy with zero restarts. No reviewed direct tenant returned a 5xx response.

rollback.routeAction: Restore the exact apex and www route IDs to their recorded prior candidate Workers using batch1 through batch12 route rollback manifests.
rollback.originAction: Restore the matching per-batch Nginx backup, validate Nginx, then reload it.
rollback.containerAction: The accepted 3133, 3134 and 3135 tenant containers and the main 3119/3128 rollback pair remain available. Rebuild any older removed image from its recorded source commit if required.
